text: 8月11日，腾讯音乐发布其截至2026年6月30日止第二季度未经审计财务业绩。第二季度总收入为人民币89.3亿元（13.2亿美元），同比增长5.8%。音乐相关服务收入同比增长11.0%至人民币76.1亿元（11.2亿美元），音乐相关会员服务收入同比增长8.1%至人民币47.9亿元（7.06亿美元）。
text_en: On August 11, Tencent Music released its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. Total revenue for the second quarter was RMB 8.93 billion (US$1.32 billion), up 5.8% year-on-year. Music-related service revenue increased 11.0% year-on-year to RMB 7.61 billion (US$1.12 billion), and music-related membership service revenue increased 8.1% year-on-year to RMB 4.79 billion (US$706 million).
